error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code.
key_rule: one control per service; only the control's own known units and port are inspected
listener_rule: /proc/net/tcp and /proc/net/udp are mandatory and /proc/net/tcp6 and /proc/net/udp6 are read when present; a TCP socket in LISTEN (0A) or a UDP socket in state 07 bound to the service port (telnet 23/tcp, ftp 21/tcp, snmp 161/udp) is a listener regardless of the owning process; the header must start with the fields sl, local_address, rem_address, st, otherwise the observation is ERROR
source_rule: fstec-configuration-2026 11.2 names Telnet, FTP and SNMPv1/v2c as examples of unused services to disable; by user decision 26.09.2026 each of the three services is one control and SNMP is checked as a whole (snmpd is not split by protocol version)
unit_rule: known units: telnet — telnet.socket, telnetd.socket, telnetd.service, inetutils-telnetd.service; ftp — vsftpd.service, proftpd.service, pure-ftpd.service; snmp — snmpd.service; systemctl show LoadState, ActiveState, UnitFileState; not-found and masked units are compliant only when not active; an active not-found or masked unit is a violation; a loaded unit that is active, activating, reloading or refreshing, or enabled, enabled-runtime, linked, linked-runtime, alias or indirect is a violation; any other LoadState or a failed query is ERROR
value_rule: VALUE is units=<unit:active/file,...|->;listeners=<port/proto,...|->; PASS only when both lists are empty
